spec.goal: Polish the redesigned Preview changes module by removing the inline selector arrow chrome and making in-page Full signal jumps scroll smoothly instead of snapping.
success_criteria: Inline stable/preview selectors no longer show the decorative dropdown arrow treatment.
Clicking Full signal animates to the target card smoothly instead of snapping abruptly.
Site build and check still pass.

Keep the polish limited to styling and in-page scroll behavior.
